regionalPayGrowthPerGapPoint.citation: Pooled OLS of a state's December-over-December change in CES average hourly earnings, less the mean of the states, on its December unemployment rate less the mean of the states (LAUS), 51 states, Decembers 2015 to 2024, 520 state-years from data/research/regional/series/state-monthly.json: slope -0.193 percentage points of pay change a year per point of unemployment gap, SE 0.071, R-squared 0.018.
